 Chapter: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts
 Section: 24::Three years.

For money payable by the defendant to the plaintiff for money received by the defendant, for the plaintiff's use.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the money is received.
